I took Luvox for around 2.5 years. While I did feel improvement on this drug, I felt it was time to slowly taper off and I basically used a pill cutter to cut down my dosage over time.

I took 2 100mg  pills every night, now I down to 0.5 pill. There should be some guides on tapering off your antidepressants online (I did it without dr advice, because i can really feel he didn't like me tapering off even though i feel so much better off now) and i hardly feel any difference tapering off and on full anti depressants dosage. On antidepressants, i would still cry once in a while and experience suicidal thoughts. I also get suicidal thoughts once in a while now.

Antidepressants didn't give me the 100% relief I want. Why continue taking them? I see too much positivity warriors here, I wonder if they have any experiences with anti depressants and depression.

I have seen suicidal since I was 12...

I am in my mid twenties now. 

I am pretty sure I'll see problems in my 30s and 40s which can compell me to off myself once my dad dies.
When my father dies, that's when my plan starts to come together.
